tasks.label: Estimate: Run az-cost for active file
Azure: List VM SKUs in region
tasks.command: REGION="${input:vmSkuRegion}"; FILTER="${input:vmSkuNameContains}"; if [ -n "$FILTER" ]; then az vm list-skus --location "$REGION" --resource-type virtualMachines --all --query "[].name" -o tsv | grep -i -- "$FILTER" | sort -u; else az vm list-skus --location "$REGION" --resource-type virtualMachines --all --query "[].name" -o tsv | sort -u; fi

inputs.description: Azure region for VM SKU lookup
Optional VM SKU name filter (contains, case-insensitive)
